meta.title: Prompt Recall
meta.description: Composer history for DeepSeek Harness: press ↑ in an empty input box to recall the previous prompt, ↑ again for older ones, ↓ to walk back; stored per workspace and survives restarts. Manage capture, caps, retention and export/import with /prompt-recall or Settings → Prompt History. Since 0.8.0 a sparkle button next to the model selector rewrites the draft with the current model and keeps @ references intact; the result only lands in the composer, you still send it.
